title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking to hire a Full Stack Engineer who will be responsible building AI-powered products for our client who is industry leader in logistics, transportation, delivery and technology-enabled services based Dubai.

This position is a contract role with an initial duration of 12 months and is renewable
The role sits within the Innovation Studio, and reports directly to the Director of Product Innovation

We are looking for a passionate Full stack Product Engineer to Design and build complete web applications: frontend, backend, APIs and data pipelines . You should also have experience in building AI/ML features that reached real users in production.

Key responsibilities:

AI Opportunity Identification: Work with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities where AI can reduce operational effort, cost and delays. Translate business challenges into clearly defined use cases with measurable outcomes, assess their potential value and recommend practical solutions. Prepare concise scoping documents outlining requirements, risks, costs and pilot plans.
Full-Stack Product Engineering: Design, build and deploy end-to-end web applications, including frontend, backend, APIs and data pipelines. Develop user-friendly interfaces for operational teams, integrate with internal systems and external APIs, and take prototypes through to production in collaboration with QA and DevOps teams.
Applied AI & Language Models: Develop AI-powered solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) to process Arabic and English text, messages, addresses and documents. Apply retrieval, data extraction, classification and tool-use techniques. Select appropriate models based on accuracy, performance, cost and data residency, ensuring effective human handover and fallback processes.
AI Evaluation & Responsible Use: Establish evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business impact. Monitor quality, cost and latency in production, identify performance issues, and ensure solutions meet relevant data governance and cybersecurity requirements. Document model behaviour, limitations and evaluation results.
Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement: Own assigned projects from initial scoping through development, deployment and post-launch support. Engage with frontline teams to understand operational needs, communicate progress and risks, and present solutions and results to stakeholders. Ensure appropriate documentation and handover to support ongoing operations.

Knowledge, skills & experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.
4–6 years of software engineering experience, developing and delivering full-stack web applications.
2+ years of experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions in production, including evaluation and monitoring.
Proven ability to take products from initial concept through to delivery and adoption with minimal supervision.
Experience in operational environments such as logistics, customer service or field operations is advantageous. Working knowledge of Arabic is also a plus.

Technical Skills

Development: TypeScript/JavaScript (React or Next.js), Python, Node.js or FastAPI, REST APIs and SQL/PostgreSQL.
AI & Machine Learning: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, AI evaluation and classical machine learning (scikit-learn).
Data & Cloud: Arabic and multilingual text processing, data pipelines and Azure cloud.
Engineering Practices: CI/CD, Docker, Git, application security and data handling.

Availability:

Preference will be given to candidates available immediately or a maximum 30 days after accepting the offer.

We are looking for a candidate who will be able to work in United Arab Emirates. Please apply with your resume and remember to provide us with your contact details.

We will review your job application within 7 working days. Should your profile fit the requirements of the role a consultant from Edari will be in touch with you to get a deeper understanding of your profile, to discuss the role in more detail and potential next steps
